# Demo preflight

1. The Census key, `CENSUS_API_KEY`, works (the live population tools need it): `uv run python scripts/census_key_check.py` prints a line starting `key works`.
2. The models image is built (the modelled cloud runs in it): `docker image ls hazbrief-models:latest` prints one row, `hazbrief-models` `latest`.
3. No models container is left from an earlier run (Issue `ddfdd4e3`): `docker ps --filter ancestor=hazbrief-models` prints the header line only.
4. No earlier `--serve` holds the start page's port: `lsof -nP -iTCP:8790 -sTCP:LISTEN` prints nothing; otherwise stop that server with Ctrl-C.
5. Swap is not exhausted (HB-207's live runs met it exhausted and were stopped): `sysctl vm.swapusage` prints `free` well above zero; if it is near zero, close other work or restart first.
6. The network answers and the forecast has wind at a prepared point: `uv run python the HB-208 evidence (held privately)` prints one line per prepared point with its forecast wind now and its forecast precipitation over the next six hours.
7. If a live cloud is refused: a calm forecast (0 km/h) draws no cloud by design (Issue `473bdfeb`; HB-208's run at Point of Rocks met it at 21:29 EST): pick a row whose point has wind, move the point, or choose `stated` weather with a direction, speed and basis. Rain no longer stops the cloud (HB-221): a forecast with precipitation draws it, run dry, and the checklist says so.
8. A cloud refused at the engine's domain edge in a light night wind (Issue `d5bcfffb`): open the recorded run instead and say so. Rain no longer stops the cloud (HB-221): a forecast with precipitation draws it, run dry, and the checklist says so.
9. A recorded brief by replay (no engine, no model call): `uv run hazbrief brief docs/briefs/csx-point-of-rocks-night/scenario.json --serve --replay --now 2026-10-26T12:00:00Z`; it serves http://127.0.0.1:8790/ and loaded in 73.1 s in HB-192 (`docs/evidence/hb192/live_load.tsv`). With `GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` set the page draws Google's basemap and its Traffic switch at 127.0.0.1 (Google refuses the key at localhost); without the key it draws Leaflet's.
10. Window: a 1440 by 900 viewport, the size of the deck's screenshots. Keep the EXERCISE banner, top and bottom, in frame.
11. If a page does not load: `docs/evidence/hb192/csx_night_status_mid_run.png`, `docs/evidence/hb192/csx_night_frame_60.png`, `docs/evidence/hb192/csx_night_frame_180.png`, `docs/evidence/hb192/csx_night_tevv_benchmarks.png`, `docs/submission/demo/csx_night_first_view.png`, `docs/submission/demo/csx_night_timeline.png`.
12. The container: README's three lines serve the seven tools; its build needs the network (`docs/evidence/hb197/readme_container.md`).
13. Size: 50 MB is 400 megabits; a 5-minute video (300 s) must average under 1.33 Mbit/s, sound included; a 3-minute video (180 s) must average under 2.22 Mbit/s, sound included. Check the export with `scripts/check_video.sh demo.mp4` (exit 1 over the limit).
14. Over the limit: re-encode to H.264, `ffmpeg -i recording.mov -c:v libx264 -preset slow -b:v 1000k -maxrate 1200k -bufsize 2400k -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 96k -movflags +faststart demo.mp4`.
